dr. frankenstein.bio: Dr. Frankenstein is an alternate recording credit for Toronto rapper, producer and remixer Frank Fallico, better known as Frankenstein. A key figure in Canada's mid-1990s underground hip-hop scene, he founded the Knowledge of Self label, earned consecutive Juno nominations for The Rain Is Gone and UV and produced work for artists including Choclair and Maestro Fresh Wes.

jessie simmons.bio: Jessie Simmons is a Haitian-Canadian singer-songwriter from Ottawa whose music blends R&B and soul with Afro-Caribbean styles including kompa and zouk. Her debut album AMONI won Album of the Year at the Kilimanjaro Music Awards, and she has performed at Canadian Music Week, JunoFest, AfroFest and Ottawa Bluesfest while remaining active in Ottawa's music community.

ray robinson.bio: Ray Robinson is a Canadian R&B singer-songwriter associated with Toronto's independent soul and urban music scene. Active since the 2000s, he has released projects including What It Is, Do You Hear Me and SUNray, with his work spanning contemporary R&B, soul and hip-hop collaborations.
